verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter explicitly says on its NIW page that it responds to any requests for evidence at no extra cost. That is documented RFE-response work beyond the initial filing, and the firm also flags RFE coverage as a question buyers should ask. The commitment is a single line: there is no detail on how RFE responses are handled, and it is stated only for NIW cases. Missing for 10: NOID response coverage, a description of the RFE response process, RFE coverage stated for other petition types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings

citations.quote: We respond to any requests for evidence at no additional cost.
